title: Cell-image measurements and honest classification
citation: Wolberg, Mangasarian, Street and Street (1993), Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), UCI.
observation_unit: One digitized fine-needle-aspirate image summary. The scikit-learn snapshot does not retain original IDs.
scope_limitations: 569 rows; 30 features. Educational observational data, not clinical validation.
acquisition: offline export from installed package distribution; no invented records
transforms: Preserved package data values and row order; added zero-based row_id.
Normalized CSV serialization; replaced spaces/slashes in sklearn feature names.
Provider label codes preserved and mapped explicitly; not original UCI IDs.
